item.title: 7 Dangers of Using AI to Fill Emotional Needs
item.description: AI is everywhere, and as much as it seems to fill voids, streamline efficiency, and alleviate stress, it is not the ultimate solution for all you need in life. Many in this world have faced deep wounds of rejection, experienced fear of abandonment, and deeply desire an entity that will not fail them, so they seek refuge in things such as AI for emotional needs. item.description: The article explores five strategic ways to steward a tax refund, moving beyond impulsive spending to impactful financial decisions. Discover how to make your refund work for you, whether by reducing debt, investing wisely, or generously supporting those in need.

item.title: 8 Easter Prayers to Celebrate the Resurrection
item.description: Celebrate Resurrection Sunday with heartfelt prayers of praise, thanksgiving, and worship, reflecting on Jesus' victory over death and the redemption it offers. Discover 8 powerful prayers designed to deepen your awe and connection to Christ's sacrifice and the new life it brings.
